projects.name: inVectus
projects.context: Local-first desktop tool that finds coverage gaps in research collections. v0.1.0 released for macOS with a one-line installer; Windows/Linux beta in testing. MIT licensed.
projects.stack: React, TypeScript, Tauri, Rust, DuckDB, LanceDB
bullets: Architected a local research workspace with typed React/TypeScript screens, a Tauri command boundary, and Rust engine crates shared by the desktop and CLI; designed import, map, and evidence-review flows.
Applied semantic retrieval and embedding-space coverage analysis to document collections; kept scores and source evidence inspectable, with experimental assessments scoped to the indexed collection.

Implemented keyboard-resizable panes with narrow-window stacking, persistent bookmarks and decisions, and resumable indexing; added navigation, map-focus, search-presentation, and layout regression coverage.
Set up release tooling: cross-platform GitHub Actions CI, installers with install smoke tests, and a macOS signing pipeline; designed and built the invectus.app product website.

projects.name: Angrove
projects.context: Private, on-device AI study harness. iPhone public beta on TestFlight; native Mac app in development.
projects.stack: Swift, SwiftUI, Core ML, MiniLM, LiteRT-LM
bullets: Created the Figma visual and interaction system and SwiftUI flows for branching conversations, contextual definitions, and a semantic map of saved Insights; built spatial study Boards on Mac.

Architected shared feature logic and design tokens for iPhone and Mac; integrated local generation, Core ML embeddings, cosine-similarity retrieval, and AES-256-GCM storage with Keychain-managed keys.
Coordinated model work through one cancellable queue; used stable conversation and branch IDs to preserve late answers after navigation, with persistence and retrieval regression coverage.
Compared thinking on/off across 80 development cases on simulator CPU: both totaled 74/80 objective passes; roughly doubled median answer time supported leaving thinking off by default.
